_meanings:
²1 To bow down, salute, make a low obeisance to, be humble (with <ab>acc.</ab>
 or dative); {#na praRamanti devatAByaH#} <ls>K. 108</ls>; {#tAM BaktipravaRena cetasA#}
 {#praRanAma#} <ls>K. 228</ls>; <ls>Ku. 7. 27</ls>; {#tasmAt praRamya praRiDAya kAyam#} <ls>Bg. 11. 44</ls>;

 <ls>R. 2. 21</ls>. ({#sAzwANgaM praRam#} ‘to fall down on the eight limbs’; see
 {#azwANga#}; {#daRqavat praRam#} ‘to bow by throwing oneself down on the ground
 quite prostrate and flat like a stick placed horizontally, touching the
 ground at all points’; <ab>cf.</ab> {#daRqapraRAma#}).

To cause to bow down; {#tAmarcitAByaH kuladevatAByaH kulapratizWAM praRamagya#}
 {#mAtA#} <ls>Ku. 7. 27</ls>.
